query: SELECT to_jsonb(a)||jsonb_build_object('owner_epoch',o.epoch) AS "data!" FROM whatsapp_linked_account a LEFT JOIN whatsapp_session_owner o ON o.account_id=a.id WHERE a.state IN ('connecting','connected','offline','reconnect') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM meta_messaging_send s WHERE s.linked_account_id=a.id AND s.state IN ('sending','unknown') AND s.dispatch_started_at IS NOT NULL AND s.provider_message_id IS NULL) ORDER BY a.updated_at,a.id LIMIT 100
